summary: LyondellBasell Industries N.V. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its structured accounts receivables facility (Eighth Amendment to Receivables Purchase Agreement). The amendment extends the facility term to June 25, 2027, reduces the maximum amount from $900M to $700M, and updates terms to align with the company's senior unsecured revolving credit facility. No trade receivable purchases or letters of credit were outstanding as of the filing date. This is a routine financing arrangement modification, not a special situation event. There are no deal terms, premiums, or advisor involvement.
